title: The Green Jungle - Near Restaurants, Coffee & Bars
description:
Welcome to The Kaleidoscope! This renovated and stylish condo is the perfect spot for your trip to Nashville! Only 3 miles (less than 10 minutes) to downtown Broadway bars! Walking distance to restaurants, coffee and grocery stores. Near hot spots such as Pearl Diver, The Wash and Pelican & Pig. Located in the trendy and eclectic East Nashville neighborhood, you’ll be surrounded by cool cafes, art galleries, boutique shopping, and live music hotspots. Free parking, and washer/dryer on site.

The space
Welcome to The Kaleidoscope! 

HIGHLIGHTS: 

★ 3 Beds - 1 King Bed, 1 Air Mattress, 1 Double Futon
★ 1 Full size spacious bathroom connected to the bedroom + 1 Half bath connected to living room
★ Smart TV in living room
★ FREE parking
★ Walk to restaurants, coffee shops, bars, and shopping (walk score of 87, meaning "very walkable")
★ Located in the Hip & Trendy East Nashville area called 5 Points 
★ Only 3 miles to Downtown Broadway Bars
★ Community Washer/Dryer on site (free to use)
★ Fully equipped kitchen for all of your cooking needs
★ High-speed internet
★ Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner and body wash provided
★ Adjustable thermostat
★ Hassle-free check-in with no keys, just codes 
★ Closet to store your items in
★ Coffee Maker
★ Located on the 1st floor - few stairs to climb
★ Near Nashville hot spots including Butcher & Bee, Bartaco, WeWork, 5 Points Pizza, Edley’s BBQ, Basement East, Smith & Lentz Brewery and so much more!
★ Two Grocery stores nearby - Publix and Kroger

BEDS: 
Bedroom 1: 1 King Bed Bed + 1 Air Mattress 
Living Room: 1 Double Futon

BATHROOM: 
Bathroom 1: Full size with stand up shower
Bathroom 2: Half bath

After a fun day out exploring Nashville, come back to relax in this chic and comfy condo. The space is the perfect mix of style + comfort. All aspects of the home have been thoughtfully designed with ease + convenience in mind. Although parking is free, you don't need a car for this location. Many things are within walking distance as we are located in a popular are in East Nashville. Both the airport & Opry are only 15 minutes away. There are plenty of Ubers, Lyft and taxis available. Our condo is in a great location to enjoy all the things that Nashville has to offer.
